title: Patterned Wafer Inspection - Mounds Detection on Surfscan SP5
subtitle: Post-Implant Quality Validation for 14nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Yuki Tanaka

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Surfscan SP5 system to detect and classify Mounds defects during post-implant inspection at the 14nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 15 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Mounds defects that are critical to yield at the 14nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Surfscan SP5 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Surfscan SP5
- Inspection Type: Patterned Wafer Inspection
- Target Defect: Mounds
- Process Step: Post-Implant
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 14nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 15

This test case applies to all Surfscan SP5 systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 15 for post-implant monitoring in the 14nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Surfscan SP5
Software Version: v8.8.145
Recipe: PATTERNED_WAFER_INSPECTION_14nm_POST_IMPLANT
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: Medium (132 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 1.0μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: 9-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Surfscan SP5 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Patterned Wafer Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Mounds defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 14nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 66 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 91% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.7% for Patterned Wafer Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.94 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2025-06-19
Wafers Tested: 11
Total Defects Found: 1810
Defect Density: 576.14 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 3.9%
Capture Rate: 90.1%
Test Duration: 340 minutes
System Uptime: 99.5%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Surfscan SP5 demonstrated excellent performance in detecting Mounds at the 14nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Minor calibration drift was detected after extended run; re-calibration resolved the issue.

e) Recipe portability between systems at this fab was confirmed.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
